intent_snapshot.goal: unified-lane-sessions S1 (#570; Spec docs/specs/unified-lane-sessions.spec.md D9, D16, D19, BR-REQ-1, BR-REQ-3, BR-REQ-5, BR-SCN-4). Retire the top-level herdr configuration key: herdr in a user or project .imm/config.json is ignored and emits one non-blocking warning diagnostic retired_key at key path herdr, is omitted from resolved config, and is never written by imm-kernel config migrate (--write removes it). Add top-level session_providers: a non-empty ordered list of distinct registered provider names (herdr, herdr-core), default ["herdr"], project replacing user; empty lists, unknown or test-only names (fake, process), duplicates, and non-arrays emit a blocking config_invalid error diagnostic. Remove the herdr gate at host-core/runtime.ts:1438 so inside Herdr (HERDR_ENV=1) Host single-task entries return an interactive Herdr-tab handoff without lane_executor_requires_tui. Update ADR 0041 Decision 4 and docs/reference/immune-brain-config.md (plus dist mirror and bundles).

acceptance.assertion: In tests/layered-config.test.ts: herdr: true and herdr: "yes" in user and project config files each produce one warning diagnostic with code retired_key at key path herdr, zero error diagnostics, an empty batchConfigErrors result, and a resolved config with no herdr field; unknown_top_key: 1 still produces a config_invalid error diagnostic (negative control).

In tests/layered-config.test.ts: imm-kernel config migrate on a v1 config whose transport chose herdr writes no herdr key; migrate --write on a v2 config containing herdr deletes only herdr and preserves every other key verbatim.

In tests/layered-config.test.ts: absent session_providers resolves to ["herdr"] with source default; project ["herdr", "herdr-core"] overrides user ["herdr-core"]; [], ["process"], ["fake"], ["herdr", "herdr"], and "herdr" each produce a config_invalid error diagnostic at session_providers and a non-empty batchConfigErrors result.

In tests/pi-batch-authority.test.ts and tests/claude-batch-authority.test.ts: a Host single-task start_unattended_batch with HERDR_ENV=1, a Pi or Claude Code Executor, and either no herdr key or herdr: false (negative control) returns an interactive executor handoff, never reports lane_executor_requires_tui, and spawns zero Executor processes.

docs/reference/immune-brain-config.md documents session_providers and retired_key without describing herdr as an active switch; docs/adr/0041-simplified-configuration.md Decision 4 matches; dist mirrors, Claude bundle, Antigravity artifact, and typecheck are current.
